dedupe_keys.name: a fine grained dataset for sewage outfalls objective detection in natural environments

description: A fine-grained dataset for sewage outfalls objective detection in natural environments is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Yuqing Tian et al. Pollution sources release contaminants into water bodies via sewage outfalls (SOs). Using high-resolution images to interpret SOs is laborious and expensive because it needs specific knowledge and must be done by hand. Integrating unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and deep learning technology could assist in constructing an automated effluent SOs detection tool by gaining specialized knowledge. Coverage: not stated; published in 2024. Formats: Excel, Image. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
